assumptions: The log response refers toY/Yref;Yref is a fixed positive reference quantity and coefficients were fitted under that normalization.
Coefficients are supplied, not estimated. The predictor may be signed when meaningful in its declared context.
limitations: Exponentiating a fitted conditional log mean gives a geometric mean; it is a conditional median under lognormal errors, not an unbiased arithmetic-mean prediction.
Arithmetic-mean retransformation needs an error-distribution correction, absent here.
